provider: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, School Basic Survey 2025
education_scope: Tokyo Metropolis national/public/private high schools, full-time and part-time regular courses; excludes correspondence courses and separately tabulated integrated secondary schools; main-duty teacher persons, not FTE

higher_education.count_location: University headquarters, explicitly not faculty/student location
higher_education.population_vintage: Original 2025-05-28 published estimate based on 2020 census; not a claim of latest rebased population
higher_education.condition: Accept recognized university headquarters as qualifying institutional location. Other HE types, branches and independently qualified institutions are not claimed exhausted.
higher_education.not_measured: Student seats, admissions, affordability, individual campus access, complete higher-education inventory
